definitions.text: Any average of the molar mass for a non-uniform polymer, with the symbol specifying the type of average.

notes.1: Number-average, mass-average and other molar-mass averages are distinct.
notes.2: Only a few types of averages are directly accessible experimentally and are obtained by specified methods.
notes.3: Any molar-mass average can be defined in terms of mass fractions or mole fractions.
